description.value: Coffeehouse at Shoal Point is a coffee shop tucked inside the Shoal Point condominium complex on Dallas Road along Victoria's southern waterfront. Its location puts it directly on a popular cycling corridor connecting the Inner Harbour to Beacon Hill Park and the Dallas Road seawall. OSM notes outdoor seating, making it a plausible rest stop for cyclists passing through.

address.value: Unit 110, 19 Dallas Road, Victoria, BC V8V 5A6

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 23m; rack at 31m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch returned a Facebook 'temporarily blocked' page with no usable content, so all evidence comes from OSM tags alone. OSM confirms free Wi-Fi (internet_access=yes, internet_access:fee=no) and outdoor seating (outdoor_seating=yes); all other amenities including bike parking, washrooms, and water refill are unverifiable. The business is not flagged as closed in OSM and the record is internally consistent.
concerns: Website URL points to a Facebook page which returned a 'temporarily blocked' access error during prefetch — no usable content was extracted. Most amenity fields remain null as a result.
No independent business website found; Facebook page URL was discovered with only medium confidence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active cafe on a major Victoria cycling corridor. OSM record is consistent and not flagged as closed.
